lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots organized into approximately five roughly horizontal rows along the lateral flank. Spot size is inversely proportional to distance from the head, with smaller, denser clusters observed in the anterior region near the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like matrix of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges run horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient featuring high-intensity upper boundaries and shadowed ventral boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent semi-circular notch is visible on the posterior edge of the first dorsal fin. A distinct, high-luminance horizontal linear mark or scar is present on the proximal third of the upper caudal fin lobe.
